notes: Cai dat: tai file HPCONS-BIM-Setup-2.0.86.exe ben duoi, DONG Revit roi chay (can quyen Admin). - Sua loi Revit bao "The top of the Wall is lower than the base of the Wall" lam huy ca lenh (mang vua hinh tam giac sat mai). - Khong con phu vua len cot, dam THEP / go / nhom.
